# Smoke Fixture

This fixture is intended for manual `.docx` compatibility review in Microsoft Word and LibreOffice.

## Inline Formatting

Plain text with **bold**, *italic*, ~~strike~~, `inline code`, <ins>underline</ins>, and a hard break.<br>Second visual line.

See [the image section](#images) and [an external site](https://example.com/?a=1&b=2).

## Lists

- Bullet item
  - Nested bullet
- [ ] Task-style item
- [x] Completed task-style item

1. Ordered item
   1. Nested ordered item

## Table

| Feature | Status |
| --- | --- |
| **Header style** | Header row should be bold |
| `code` | Inline code in a table cell |
| <ins>underline</ins> | Limited raw HTML underline |

## Quote

> This paragraph should use the Word Quote style.

## Code

```js
const value = "smoke";
console.log(value);
```
